question: Where does the PC generate the structured Overview fields, and which of those fields does the phone's Overview tab read that phone-saved items lack?

fields_prompted.entity: { title, subtitle, rating, synopsis, actions[], attributes{} } (lines 288-304, rule 319-330)

pc_generation.parser: parse_enrichment (enrich.py:899) -> Enrichment dataclass (enrich.py:417-423: category, summary, tags, resources, entity)
pc_generation.url_resolution: resolve_and_verify_resource_urls (enrich.py:1329) + KNOWN_TOOL_URLS map (enrich.py:601-612) resolves missing URLs; this is where inferred/not-literal-in-source link chips come from (audit_20_pc_links.json: 21/58 = 36.2% not literal)
pc_generation.storage: columns category, summary, tags, entity(json), resources(json) written by reels.py capture flow (enrich.py:1117-1121, 1163-1167, 1324-1336)
pc_generation.serialization: apps/backend/backend/library/service.py as_dict() adds excerpt, content, thumbnail_url, has_thumbnail, media_url, app, author, progress (service.py:301-322)

overview_fields_read.item.entity.subtitle: LibraryTypeDetails.jsx:79
overview_fields_read.item.excerpt / item.content: postBody fallback chain MobileLibraryItem.jsx:820-833 (notes -> content -> excerpt)

missing_on_phone_saved_items.category: never generated by geminiPipeline.js prompts; getLibraryDetailScreen falls back to kind/article
missing_on_phone_saved_items.entity: never generated; EntityDetails returns null (LibraryTypeDetails.jsx:80) so Overview loses synopsis/rating/attributes/actions/subtitle
missing_on_phone_saved_items.excerpt: never generated; service.py:316-318 fallback is PC-only
missing_on_phone_saved_items.content: never generated (PC full text file field)
missing_on_phone_saved_items.kind: phone uses mediaType ('video'/'unknown') not PC kind vocabulary (article/reel/movie/book...)
missing_on_phone_saved_items.resources_shape: PC [{type,name,detail,url}] objects vs phone Gemini prompt asks for plain strings; MobileLibraryItem.jsx:875 requires r.resolved_url||r.url||r.link starting 'http' -> string entries are dropped, so phone-saved items show only the primary source link even when Gemini returned URLs
missing_on_phone_saved_items.tags: present both sides (phone: 3-7 strings; PC: canonicalized 2-3)
